name: open_savings_account
description: Log in, open the Open New Account page, choose account type SAVINGS, fund it from account {{account_id}}, submit, and read the new account number into an output named new_account_id

approved_plan.goal: Log in, open the Open New Account page, choose account type SAVINGS, fund it from account {{account_id}}, submit, and read the new account number into an output named new_account_id

steps.intent: Log in with the supplied credentials and reach the Accounts Overview page
steps.action: Replay fragment parabank_login@1.0.0 using username and password parameters

steps.intent: Navigate to the Open New Account page
steps.action: Click the 'Open New Account' link in the left-hand navigation menu

steps.intent: Select SAVINGS as the account type
steps.action: In the account type dropdown, select the 'SAVINGS' option
In the funding account dropdown, select the account matching account_id
Click the 'Open New Account' submit button

steps.intent: Read the new account number from the confirmation page into the output new_account_id
steps.action: Locate and extract the account number displayed in the confirmation/success section of the page and store it as new_account_id

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: The username used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: The password used to log in to ParaBank

parameters.name: account_id
parameters.description: The existing account ID used to fund the new savings account

approved_plan.success_signal: A confirmation page is displayed with a heading such as 'Account Opened!' or 'Congratulations, your account is now open' and the new account number is visible on the page
